references.text: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted - same theme about God's closeness to his people
The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth - direct parallel about God's closeness when we call upon him
Israel is a people who are near him - same expression about Israel's unique closeness to God
Seek the Lord while he may be found; call on him while he is near - an exhortation to seek God while he is near
God's presence sets Israel apart from all other nations on earth - same thought about Israel's unique position
What nation on earth is like your people Israel? - rhetorical question about Israel's unique status among the nations
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble, so easy to find - God's availability for his people
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you - New Testament echo of the promise of God's closeness
